response.overview: Buk Bhora Bhalobasha follows the story of Dristi, daughter of a wealthy businessman who falls in love with the son of a farmer who will be staying in their home to have higher studies. Fate takes a different turn as Robin emerges in the scene, a boy who was chosen to be Dristi's groom a long time ago.  Who will she choose, or better, who will let her to be happy?
response.title: Buk Bhora Bhalobasha
